method: Web search and page reading of brand/manufacturer product pages; country-facing official ordering/catalogue pages establish simulated selection markets. No claim of individual store stock, real price, or guaranteed zero alcohol in fermented kvass.

newMarkets.basis: Italian manufacturer catalogue lists all three flavours and formats; Italy product pages describe citrus flavours. Manufacturer origins page confirms production in Italy.

Swiss manufacturer product page plus Liechtenstein retailer's direct product page, categorised as Softdrinks and listed ab Lager. Retailer explicitly identifies Swiss origin; originCountry remains CH. Availability observed is evidence for the selection market, not a lasting store-stock promise.
Official Slovenian site lists Original and describes rosehip and herbs; local purchase promotions and Slovenian-facing brand catalogue support this market.
Manufacturer's Croatian site lists orange soft drink, formats and Split company contact. Croatian retailer direct listing independently confirms sale.
Manufacturer Hungarian order form lists Szőlő among carbonated soft drinks in multiple formats; product identity and grape flavour supported by official history.
Official Slovak brand portfolio identifies Vinea Biela and white grape flavour, including portable bottle formats.
Official manufacturer describes classic fermented kvass with bread flavour; Estonian current price list includes Klassikaline Kali. No ABV figure inferred.
Manufacturer Latvian storefront lists Latvijas rabarberu zelteris; domestic retailer confirms branded carbonated rhubarb drink.

Official Lithuanian manufacturer identifies dark rye bread kvass and sweet-sour bread flavour. IKI direct product page supports Lithuanian distribution; historical promotion is not a current price promise. No ABV figure inferred.
